en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear. 'Пусти мерак' is rendered as 'damned longing'; 'од корен ме откорна' is literally 'tore me out from the root'.

lines.cyr: Еднаш ерген бев и јас,
lines.lat: Ednaš ergen bev i jas,
lines.en: Once I too was a bachelor,

lines.cyr: сакав мома најлична,
lines.lat: sakav moma najlična,
lines.en: I loved the most beautiful girl,

lines.cyr: моја не стана, не ме засака,
lines.lat: moja ne stana, ne me zasaka,
lines.en: she did not become mine, she did not fall for me,

lines.cyr: од корен ме откорна.
lines.lat: od koren me otkorna.
lines.en: she tore me out by the root.

lines.cyr: Пијан да бев, ќе се отрезнев,
lines.lat: Pijan da bev, ḱe se otreznev,
lines.en: If I were drunk, I would sober up,

lines.cyr: болен да бев, јас ќе оздравев,
lines.lat: bolen da bev, jas ḱe ozdravev,
lines.en: if I were sick, I would get well,

lines.cyr: ама пусти мерак Ратке по тебе,
lines.lat: ama pusti merak Ratke po tebe,
lines.en: but this damned longing, Ratka, for you,

lines.cyr: никако да помине.
lines.lat: nikako da pomine.
lines.en: will not pass in any way.

lines.cyr: Со него кога минуваш,
lines.lat: So nego koga minuvaš,
lines.en: When you pass by with him,

lines.cyr: глава си наведнувам,
lines.lat: glava si navednuvam,
lines.en: I lower my head,

lines.cyr: „добро вечер“ ти ми велиш и заминуваш,
lines.lat: „dobro večer“ ti mi veliš i zaminuvaš,
lines.en: you say 'good evening' to me and walk away,

lines.cyr: а јас отруен продолжувам.
lines.lat: a jas otruen prodolžuvam.
lines.en: and I go on, poisoned.

lines.en: If I were drunk, I would sober up,

lines.en: will not pass in any way.

lines.cyr: Години натежнале, коси побелеле,
lines.lat: Godini natežnale, kosi pobelele,
lines.en: The years have grown heavy, my hair has turned white,

lines.cyr: многу лета Ратке
lines.lat: mnogu leta Ratke
lines.en: many summers, Ratka,

lines.cyr: во солзи легнувам,
lines.lat: vo solzi legnuvam,
lines.en: I lie down in tears,

lines.cyr: не знам дали ќе се разбудам.
lines.lat: ne znam dali ḱe se razbudam.
lines.en: I do not know if I will wake up.
